objects.name: fence
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE fence (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 0),
    epoch INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (epoch >= 0)
)

objects.name: format_marker
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE format_marker (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 0),
    baseline_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(baseline_sha256) = 64)
)
